family_pages.title: RChain Assurance
family_pages.description: A conceptual family grouped by observation, provenance, and evidence; it does not imply a linear lineage.

family_pages.title: CHIMERA-ONE Constellation
family_pages.description: CHIMERA-ONE is the control-plane hub. Six connected systems form the surrounding evidence-runtime constellation.

family_pages.title: Quantum + Formal Systems
family_pages.description: The quantum and formal-methods lineage: optimization workbenches, theorem artifacts, lattice experiments, and sovereign-system prototypes.

projects.name: Aether Runtime
projects.positioning: Bounded execution runtime with signed evidence, durable lineage, and replay-oriented verification surfaces.
boundaries: no blanket remote-attestation claim
no distributed-consensus claim
no arbitrary-shell safety claim

projects.name: Aether Runtime OS
projects.description: A fault-tolerant, evidence-carrying runtime for autonomous and distributed AI execution.
projects.positioning: Multi-process Aether runtime research generation focused on recovery, signed evidence, WAL-backed persistence, and deterministic replay.
boundaries: repository chronology does not establish that this codebase predates aether-runtime
runtime/replay evidence is not a formal correctness proof

projects.name: Book of Kings
projects.positioning: Local-first Persian cultural reflection product built around a structured daily ritual and Shahnameh-inspired visual language.
boundaries: consumer/cultural product rather than an engineering-verification claim
projects.label: Open live site

projects.name: LLM Security PoC
projects.positioning: Forensic red-team proof-of-concept repository for testing security failure modes in dynamic model/application architectures.
boundaries: PoC labels are not treated as established vulnerabilities in third-party targets without target-specific reproduction and evidence
severity language remains scoped to demonstrated conditions

projects.name: Nexus Quantum
projects.positioning: Quantum-optimization research repository with Lean artifacts and verification-oriented experimentation.
boundaries: presence of Lean artifacts does not certify the full system
formal scope must be audited theorem-by-theorem before a formally-verified badge is used
projects.label: Open live site

projects.name: Omni
projects.positioning: Evidence-stress and hypothesis-lattice investigation system with classical and quantum-adjacent attestation surfaces.
boundaries: integrity mechanisms demonstrate binding/consistency, not truth
quantum-adjacent artifacts do not imply quantum advantage
projects.label: Open Omni

projects.name: RCHAIN-COMPLIER
projects.positioning: Evidence-first assurance and reproducibility workbench for bounded RChain/Casper CBC experiments.
boundaries: does not treat a passing harness as a protocol safety theorem
formal-verification claims require separate formal artifacts
live-network conclusions must be tied to captured runtime evidence
projects.label: Open live site

projects.name: RChain Sentinel
projects.description: RChain transaction, contract, and network verification console
projects.positioning: Independent observation and evidence layer for RChain node/block behavior.
boundaries: does not claim independent stake-weighted Casper finality
observations are separated from protocol-level proof
projects.label: Open live site

projects.name: Rholox
projects.description: Rholox — RChain-native DApp platform and testnet gateway
projects.positioning: Evidence-first public-testnet product surface for RChain interaction and verification.
boundaries: public-testnet scope
no mainnet status claim
no production custody claim
telemetry must come from real node data
projects.label: Open Rholox

projects.name: rlsenti
projects.positioning: Deterministic RChain reality/sentinel workbench for provenance, bounded language experiments, certificates, and synthetic node observations.
boundaries: current workbench data is self-contained/synthetic unless explicitly connected to live evidence
not represented as an independent live Casper-finality verifier
projects.label: Open live site

projects.name: Sovereign Lattice
projects.positioning: Rust PBFT/consensus research system with cryptographic, persistence, and formal-method artifacts.
boundaries: formal artifacts must be scoped precisely
README-level mathematical claims are not promoted to registry facts without artifact-level verification
projects.label: Open live site

projects.name: Strategic Intelligence Lattice
projects.positioning: Reproducible decision-research environment for testing adaptive computation and multi-agent allocation hypotheses.
boundaries: failed or neutral experiments remain recorded
experimental wins are not generalized beyond their measured conditions

projects.name: VQE Analyzer
projects.description: This tool renders complex algorithmic performance landscapes in real-time using zero-dependency Vanilla JavaScript. While built for Quantum VQE, the underlying engine is production-ready for financial and industrial applications.
projects.positioning: Reproducible VQE workbench using actual statevector energy evaluation and deterministic experiment replay.
boundaries: no quantum-advantage claim
no hardware-execution claim
no global-convergence guarantee
not presented as QAOA
projects.label: Open VQE Analyzer
